modalLead: The General settings page is easier to scan: busy sections are now split into small labelled sub-groups, so related options sit together.

items.text: Clearer settings groups — the busiest General sections are now split into small labelled sub-groups so related options sit together: Localization into language and date & time, Appearance & Style into theme, text and extras, and Layout into grid, spacing and extras. Same settings, same place — just easier to scan. Nothing was moved between tabs.
